services.name: Ice Rental Guidelines
services.desc: Temple Gardens Centre’s Arena ice surface is typically available for rental from mid-September through April. Please note that the length of the ice season may be adjusted, either shortened or extended, based on the operational requirements of the Moose Jaw Warriors, the AAA Warriors, and/or overall facility needs. Below you will find information on how to rent ice, including booking details, prices, statutory holidays, and guidelines to help you plan your time on the ice. We encourage all users to review this information carefully when making arrangements. The arena will be closed on the above dates. services.name: Curling Room
services.desc: Conveniently located in the main lobby of Temple Gardens Centre, just outside the Moose Jaw Curling Centre and adjacent to the SaskTix Box Office, the Curling Room offers a comfortable and versatile space for smaller meetings and gatherings. Accommodating approximately 30 to 40 guests, this room is well suited for staff meetings, training and teaching sessions, workshops, and birthday celebrations. Designed with flexibility in mind, the Curling Room provides a welcoming and functional environment for both professional and social events.
